sources.entry: Recyclarr | Sync TRaSH Guides quality settings to Sonarr and Radarr

summary.one_liner: Recyclarr is a command-line application that automatically syncs recommended TRaSH Guides settings to Sonarr and Radarr instances.
summary.what_it_does: Recyclarr is a command-line tool that synchronizes recommended settings from the TRaSH Guides to Sonarr and Radarr. According to the README, it can sync quality profiles (including qualities and quality groups), custom formats (individually or as groups, with guide or manual scores), quality definitions (file sizes), media naming formats, and media management settings (Propers/Repacks). It supports Radarr and Sonarr v4 or newer. The README points to a Getting Started guide that describes installing it with Docker and syncing a quality profile from a ready-made template. Full documentation is hosted at recyclarr.dev.
use_cases: sync TRaSH Guides quality profiles to Sonarr
automate Sonarr and Radarr quality settings
how_to_run: Install Recyclarr with Docker, following the Getting Started guide linked in the README
Use a major version Docker tag (e.g. 8); the latest tag is not available on Docker Hub or GHCR
Sync a quality profile from a ready-made template as described in the Getting Started guide
See the Installation and Command Line Reference pages at recyclarr.dev for details
notable: Syncs TRaSH Guides recommended settings into Sonarr and Radarr automatically
Covers quality profiles, custom formats with scores, quality definitions, naming, and media management
Ready-made templates to get started quickly
Documentation hosted at recyclarr.dev with config and CLI references
caveats: The latest Docker tag is not published on Docker Hub or GHCR; a major version tag must be used
GitHub Issues are reserved for bug reports and feature requests, not general support; support is via the TRaSH-Guides Discord
Requires Sonarr v4 or newer for Sonarr support
